description:
Factor the existing pkix-difftest OpenSSL oracle to accept per-purpose arguments (-purpose, -verify_hostname, -verify_email, -verify_ip) for the wrapper-level differential tests under PKIX-fmtv.18.

The existing oracle in pkix-difftest/src/oracles/openssl.rs is chain-shape only. The wrapper-level diff needs to pass additional flags. Add a small helper API alongside the existing verify (do NOT break the chain-shape callers).

Shape sketch:
  pub struct VerifyArgs<'a> {
      pub purpose: Option<&'a str>,            // sslserver, sslclient, smimesign, smimeencrypt, codesign, timestampsign, ocsphelper
      pub verify_hostname: Option<&'a str>,
      pub verify_email: Option<&'a str>,
      pub verify_ip: Option<&'a str>,
  }
  pub fn verify_with_args(chain: &Chain, args: &VerifyArgs) -> io::Result<Verdict>;

This subbead is the precondition for every purpose-specific diff bead below it.
title: OpenSSL diff: shared wrapper-level OpenSSL oracle helper
